homepage.title: Mobile Developer : Android | IOS | Kotlin | Flutter | Kotlin Multiplatform | Java
homepage.description:
Mid-level Mobile Developer with 5+ years of experience in high-impact projects — from the Casas Bahia multi-brand e-commerce app to AI research at Samsung, systems for the SSPDS of Ceará, and mobile applications with a university patent.

Specialized in native Android and wearables (Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Kotlin Multiplatform, Flutter/Dart), with MVVM/MVI, Clean Architecture, dependency injection and a complete testing pyramid. On the back-end, microservices in Java Spring Boot, WebFlux and Scala, with Docker, Kubernetes and Apache Kafka.

about.title: I'm Davi Gomes Florencio. I live in Brazil, where I design the future.
about.greeting: My name is Davi Gomes Florencio and I am an Information Technology Technician from EEEP Capelão Frei Orlando and a Computer Science Graduate from the Federal University of Ceará Quixadá Campus,
about.map_popup:
UFC Quixadá Campus 
 Where my academic journey was consolidated.
about.intro_mobile: I am a Mid-level Mobile Developer with 5+ years of experience, focused on native Android, wearables, iOS and cross-platform, specialized in Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Kotlin Multiplatform, Java and Flutter.
about.experience_android: I currently work on the CoreApps squad of the Casas Bahia multi-brand e-commerce app (via FCamara), modernizing a mission-critical hybrid codebase: RxJava to Coroutines/Flow migration (+500 files), XML and Jetpack Compose interoperability, multi-module restructuring with SOLID and Clean Code (+40k legacy lines removed), migration to Android API 37, and certificate pinning and mTLS updates. I cut unit test build time by 60%, production APK size by 30% (R8/ProGuard) and release build time by 20%, updated the project documentation, and introduced AI into code review with GitHub Agentic Workflows. Before that, on the Samsung AI4Wellness project, I built native apps for Android and Samsung Galaxy Watch with Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, KMP, the Samsung Health Sensor SDK and 90% test coverage, now in continuous use in active research.
about.experience_backend: I complement my mobile work with Back-End in Java Spring Boot, WebFlux, Scala and Python, building REST APIs and microservices with Apache Kafka, Docker and Kubernetes, plus CI/CD with GitHub Actions, Azure Pipelines and Harness.
about.experience_data: I also work with physiological signal analysis using NeuroKit, Graph Theory, and AI agents to speed up refactoring, dependency analysis and documentation.
